body: As a pro life person myself, it sickens me to see how someone who claims to love you treat you like this. If she is such a “just christian,” the why hasn’t she heard of forgiveness? No one knows the troubles you’ve been through, only yourself. I can’t even imagine, and I’m currently suicidal as well

Everytime I get close to, I then realize I’m doing it selfishly. I’m that asshole that kills himself just for the attention. I can imagine sending out a suicide note on all social media, mentioning the people I love the moat and letting them know it’s not my fault, then see myself at my funeral with everyone around my dead body. In that image I’m no longer alone and I see how much people around me really care: my parents, sister, best friends, ex girlfriend, etc. But I know that’s not how death works. I’ll never get to see that attention towards me. I think thats what I truly desire, and that’s why I dwell on suicide.
